# HANGUK SKIN

> HANGUK SKIN (Hanguk Skin Private Limited) is an Indian company based in Gurugram, Haryana. It is the official importer and distributor of genuine Korean beauty brands in India. It carries Korean brands only, imports them through official channels, and supplies retail stores, retail chains and online marketplace sellers across India with marketing support.

## Key facts
- Legal name: Hanguk Skin Private Limited (CIN U46491HR2026PTC147722)
- Registered office: 703, 7th Floor, Palm Court, Sector-16, MG Road, Gurugram, Haryana 122007, India
- Contact: WhatsApp and phone +91 62832 89326
- "Hanguk" means Korea in Korean. Slogan: "Only Korean. Only official."
- Korean brands only. No grey-market or parallel imports.
- CDSCO import registration; the registration number (RC No.) and HANGUK SKIN's importer details are printed on every pack.
- Stock held in a bonded FTWZ warehouse in India.
- Partners can request import registration, invoices and batch details.
- Marketing support: marketplace listings, ads and reviews; in-store displays, sampling and staff training; social and creator content.
- Categories: skincare, sun care, cleansers, sheet masks, makeup.

## Guide: six checks for genuine Korean skincare in India
1. Importer name and address in India: Every imported cosmetic sold in India has to name its importer on the pack. A missing, blank or foreign-only address is a red flag.
2. Import registration number (RC No.): Imported cosmetics need a registration certificate from CDSCO, India's national regulator for drugs and cosmetics. Its number is printed on the pack, usually marked RC No. or Reg. Cert. No.
3. MRP in rupees, inclusive of all taxes: Packs meant for sale in India show a maximum retail price in rupees, inclusive of all taxes. A pack with only a Korean or US price was not packed for sale here.
4. Country of origin, spelled correctly: Look for "Made in Korea" or "Country of origin: Republic of Korea". Spelling mistakes on the label are a common sign of fakes.
5. Batch number, manufacturing and expiry dates: These should be printed clearly and match on the box and the product. Scratched-off, covered or re-printed dates are a warning sign.
6. Consumer care details: Retail packs in India list a contact for complaints, such as a phone number or email. No contact usually means no one is responsible for the product.

## FAQ
Q: What is HANGUK SKIN?
A: HANGUK SKIN (Hanguk Skin Private Limited) is an Indian company based in Gurugram, Haryana. We officially import and distribute genuine Korean beauty brands in India and support our retail partners with marketing.

Q: Is HANGUK SKIN an Indian company?
A: Yes. Hanguk Skin Private Limited is registered in India, CIN U46491HR2026PTC147722, with its registered office at 703, 7th Floor, Palm Court, Sector-16, MG Road, Gurugram, Haryana 122007.

Q: What does "Hanguk" mean?
A: Hanguk means Korea in Korean. It is the only place our brands come from.

Q: Do you only carry Korean brands?
A: Yes. We carry Korean beauty brands only, and we plan to keep it that way as we grow.

Q: Are your products genuine?
A: Yes. Every product we supply is imported officially by HANGUK SKIN, carries our importer details on the pack and comes with its documents. We do not deal in grey-market or parallel imports.

Q: Are your products registered with CDSCO?
A: Products we import are registered for import with CDSCO, and the registration number (RC No.) is printed on the pack.

Q: Can I see import documents?
A: Yes. Partners can request the import registration, invoices and batch details for products we supply.

Q: What categories do you bring in?
A: Skincare such as serums, essences and moisturisers, plus sun care, cleansers, sheet masks and makeup.

Q: Who do you supply?
A: Beauty and skincare stores, retail chains and online marketplace sellers across India.

Q: What are the order terms?
A: They depend on your range and channel. We share them in writing after our first conversation.

Q: Do you help with marketing?
A: Yes. We support the brands we carry with online, offline and digital marketing: marketplace listings, in-store displays, sampling, staff training, and social and creator content.

Q: How do I start?
A: Message us on WhatsApp or call +91 62832 89326. Tell us your store or company name, city, channel and the categories you are interested in.

Q: How can I tell if a Korean product is genuine?
A: Check the back of the pack for the Indian importer name and address, the RC No., an MRP in rupees, the country of origin, batch and dates, and consumer care details. See the full guide.

Q: Where can I buy your products?
A: We supply retail stores and online marketplaces in India. Look for Hanguk Skin Private Limited as the importer on the pack.

Q: Is a product without an Indian MRP sticker always fake?
A: Not always. But it was not officially imported for sale in India, so it may not have been registered, stored or labelled for the Indian market.

Q: What should I do if I think a product is fake?
A: Stop using it, keep the pack and the bill, and contact the seller. You can also raise a complaint with the National Consumer Helpline (1915).

Q: Do these checks work for any brand?
A: Yes. They apply to any imported cosmetic sold in India, not only the brands we carry.

Q: What are the order terms?
A: They depend on your range and channel. We share terms in writing after our first conversation.

Q: Which cities do you supply?
A: We work with partners across India. Tell us your city and we will confirm delivery and terms.

Q: How soon can we start?
A: It depends on the range and stock. We give you a written plan before you place an order.

Q: Can you help us sell on online marketplaces?
A: Yes. Our marketing support covers marketplace listings, ads and reviews as well as in-store work.

Q: Do you carry non-Korean brands?
A: No. We carry Korean brands only.
